notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). Reference for Google Cloud Secret Manager: enabling the API, creating/versioning/accessing/disabling/destroying secrets with gcloud, IAM bindings, GKE Workload Identity and the Secrets Store CSI driver, Python/Go/Node SDK samples, a rotation Cloud Function, rotation schedules and Terraform.

Medium: following it can make the agent run gcloud commands against the user's project with their configured credentials that read secret values (`gcloud secrets versions access`, SKILL.md:70-73), add versions, change IAM policy, update a GKE cluster, and irreversibly destroy a version or delete a secret (SKILL.md:90-94, labelled permanent). Acceptable because these are a command reference for the user's own secret-management task, not steps to run unprompted; users should confirm before destroy/delete and IAM changes.

Caveats: example values ('S3cur3P@ssw0rd!', 'N3wS3cur3P@ss!', 10.0.1.5, my-project) are placeholders, but piping literal secrets through echo leaves them in shell history; the Go sample prints the secret value (SKILL.md:363); the rotation Cloud Function (SKILL.md:398-420) writes a new random password version without changing the database password, so it would break consumers if used as-is. Related Skills (SKILL.md:506-509) link to sibling skills ../hashicorp-vault/, ../../../infrastructure/cloud-gcp/gcp-gke/, ../aws-secrets-manager/, ../azure-keyvault/ as optional reading only.
